FACT_ID: sec04-R01 | anchor: A01
Engagement means hands, eyes, and mind together, and any new medication needs a driving-effects consult [A01].
Why it matters: group engagement; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec04-F01 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0041]

FACT_ID: sec04-R02 | anchor: A01
Older drivers adapt through exams, drug reviews, fitness, car aids, clear lenses after dark, and calm travel hours [A01].
Why it matters: group older-drivers; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec04-F02 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0041]

FACT_ID: sec04-R03 | anchor: A02
Visual, manual, and cognitive distraction differ by eyes, hands, and mind, and texting alone spans all three [A02].
Why it matters: group distraction; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec04-F04 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0042]

FACT_ID: sec04-R04 | anchor: A02
Texting while driving is banned everywhere while handheld use is banned in school and work zones [A02].
Why it matters: group device-bans; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec04-F04 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0042]

FACT_ID: sec04-R05 | anchor: A03
Judgment fails before reflexes and sight, and no experience level makes a single drink safe [A03].
Why it matters: group alcohol; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec04-F06 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec04-R06 | anchor: A03
A DUI stain lasts 75 years, so drinkers lock in a sober driver or a hired ride beforehand [A03].
Why it matters: group dui-fallout; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec04-F07 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec04-R07 | anchor: A03
Fatigue dulls thought into microsleep, and long trips break every 100 miles or 2 hours with naps and buddy swaps [A03].
Why it matters: group drowsy; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec04-F08 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec04-R08 | anchor: A04
Drugs match alcohol penalties, labels and doctors gate safe use, and mixing multiplies a single drink into several [A04].
Why it matters: group drugs; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec04-F09 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec04-R09 | anchor: A04
Strong feelings demand calming before driving, while a raging stranger demands distance, yielding, averted eyes, and a call [A04].
Why it matters: group emotions-rage; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec04-F10, sec04-F11 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0044]
